name: Vestra Player AI
author: Vestra Player
punchline: Chat with your chosen model; let AI write Vestra plugins: check, test, install, export (BYOK, experimental)
description:
Vestra Player AI is the AI assistant inside the player, based on pi (github.com/earendil-works/pi). Choose a provider in the settings (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, or an OpenAI-compatible service such as Ollama) and save your own API key to start a conversation.

Each conversation has its own folder; the AI can only read and write that folder and cannot run commands. The API key is kept only in the system keychain, never in a file. The cost of calling the model is charged to your provider account.

The AI writes plugins from the plugin SDK's documentation and fixes its own errors with the type check, tests and packing tools; a finished plugin can be installed or exported as a .vxp or as a complete source project.
